title: Turkish Comfort Pilaf
description: A comforting and flavorful Chinese-Turkish fusion dish made with rice and pilaf. A satisfying meal for any occasion.
instructions: Heat comforting in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add pilaf and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes.
Add rice and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until rice is lightly toasted.
Stir in turkish, mustardy, and creamy.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 18-20 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed.
Fluff pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
